description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Shadow King], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Fire, Dark)] and [Dark Phantom Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Shadow King
description.text: Dark and Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Fire, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Dark] after using a Fire/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Dark Phantom Mode
description.text: Instant cast speed, casts Destruction after using a Dark or Fire ability, removed after triggering three times

description.name: Destruction
description.text: Causes [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)] and [Buff Dark 10% (15s)] to the user

description.name: Buff Fire 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Dark 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
